headline: Sixth straight record quarter as loans and deposits surge
summary_short: Wintrust posted record quarterly net income of $233.7 million ($3.30 diluted EPS), up 2.8% q/q and 19.5% y/y, as total loans grew $1.6 billion and deposits grew $2.2 billion during the second quarter of 2026.
summary_long: Net interest income rose to $597.4M (+3% q/q) on $2.1B average earning-asset growth, though NIM slipped 4bp to 3.50% (3.52% FTE) on lower loan yields. Non-interest income rose to $141.3M on higher mortgage banking revenue, partly offset by lower wealth management fees. Non-interest expense rose to $397.5M on higher marketing and comp costs, partly offset by a $5.2M FDIC assessment reversal. Provision for credit losses fell to $23.1M as net charge-offs declined to 10bp of average loans; non-performing loans held near 0.32% of total loans. Total assets grew $2.5B to $74.7B on loan and deposit growth; CET1 stood at 10.4%. Management gave no explicit numeric guidance for Q3 but expects continued loan growth and NII expansion.
